name: 3d-print-shop
description: Describe it. Print it. A team of skills that turns a description, photo or sketch into a print-ready STL/3MF for Bambu Lab, Prusa and Elegoo printers, powered by the Sloyd API: printable prompt design, 3D generation, watertight repair and mm scaling, multi-colour AMS parts, personalised gifts and a social reel plan.
